evidence.levels: SkillAcquireData Mastery rows of SkillLevel 2+: level, CostSkillPoint, NeedCharacterLevel
evidence.classes: PCCreationInfo Class, then PcData Class rows without a creation row (Fighter)
evidence.damage: Damage EffectValueList, candidate reading: flat min/max, weapon ratio min/max (1/10000)
evidence.abnormals: SkillAbnormal GroupId + SkillAbnormalEffect rows of the self_abnormals (SkillEffectFilter EffectRangeType Self) and target_abnormals (other filters) (build 26262663)
evidence.effect_levels: SkillEffectLv.dat by the SkillEffectLvGroupId of a Damage row (level_group): flat min/max and PvP flat min/max for skill levels 2+ (build 26262663)
evidence.weapon_type: most frequent NeedMainWeaponTypes of the class's auto-learned skills
evidence.starter_weapons: Item.dat equip_wp_<Type>_<L|D>_c_begin_001a_b (L for race 1, D for race 2)
evidence.chains: Skill.dat ChainSkillPrevSkillId/AvailableTime/ActivateRate/DeactivateType; chain-only player skills reachable from the auto-learned ones added (A2Core PR #4)
evidence.projectile: Skill.dat SkillEffectTimeDataList ProjectileId of the time row a Damage row belongs to
evidence.projectile_speeds: SkillProjectile.dat Speed (newest research/local export naming the table)
evidence.charges: SkillCharge.dat ChargeMinTime, bMovableInCharge, SkillChargeDataList {ChargeTime, ChargeSkillId}; a cast row has charge = its Skill.dat ChargeId; the step skills are added as cast rows
